title: Route remaining native UI paint through the Frequency token contract
detail: The web token guard excludes mobile. Native Button, D-pad, Switch and device LED wheel retained raw white/rgba literals outside the declared token source. Move primary-action rim, switch thumb and shadow, and physical RGB-wheel neutral white into named Frequency roles; both palettes preserve their exact prior values. Computed RGB device data remains data rather than a UI palette. A recursive native-source consequence probe failed on four files before repair and now enforces the documented token-only boundary. All nine native pure tests pass. This does not prove native rendering or hardware behavior: the isolated checkout lacks the native dependency install, Android toolchain and attached device. No palette redesign or dependency installation.

verify.note: Recursively check the native source tree for fixed hex/rgb paint outside theme/tokens.ts, while permitting computed physical RGB device values.
